title: Corolla Cross Z
tagline: Top-grade Corolla Cross with full aero kit, panoramic roof and genuinely low mileage.
about: This is the flagship Z grade, the one buyers ask for by name. It came out of the auction with a complete aero kit already fitted, a panoramic roof and the hybrid drivetrain that returns real economy in Rajshahi traffic. Mileage is unusually low for the year and the sheet shows no structural repair history.

title: Corolla Cross S Package
tagline: Same platform and hybrid engine as the Z, several lakh less. The sensible buy.
about: The S Package sits one step below the Z but keeps almost everything you actually use day to day: the body kit, the camera system and the black contrast roof. If the Z stretches the budget, this is the smarter car for the money.

title: C-HR Hybrid — Pearl Two Tone
tagline: High-grade C-HR with the full black aero kit, gloss alloys and premium interior trim.
about: The sharpest looking car on the lot. Factory pearl white over black cladding with the complete aero package, and the paint is original, not a respray. The hybrid system does most of the low-speed work on battery, so city fuel bills stay low.

title: C-HR Hybrid — Red Wine
tagline: Sporty hybrid crossover in a red wine metallic that almost never lands in Bangladesh.
about: The C-HR is the easiest car here to live with in a city. Compact footprint, light steering, and a hybrid system that keeps running costs down. This unit is in the red wine metallic, a colour we see maybe once a year at auction.

title: Yaris Cross Z Leather
tagline: Compact SUV in the top Z Leather trim — comfort, economy and a high seating position.
about: Small enough for narrow roads, tall enough for broken ones. The Z Leather grade adds heated leather seats, a power tailgate and the full driver-assist suite. This is the car we recommend most often to buyers stepping up from a sedan.
